sloka: यथा विनिहतः सङ्ख्ये रावणो देवकम्टकः ।समागमश्च त्रिदशैर्यथा दत्तश्च ते वरः ।सर्वं ममैतद्विदितं तपसा धर्मवत्सल ।। ६.१२७.१५ ।।
transliteration: yathā vinihataḥ saṅkhye rāvaṇo devakamṭakaḥ ।samāgamaśca tridaśairyathā dattaśca te varaḥ ।sarvaṁ mamaitadviditaṁ tapasā dharmavatsala ।। 6.127.15 ।।

translations.english: "O, you are a lover of rightful duty, seeing Maricha, searching Sita, appearance of Kabhanda, your going to Pampa, making friendship with Sugriva, killing of Vali, searching for Vaidehi, finding of Sita by the son of wind god, and his action, setting fire to Lanka, finding of Nalasethu, construction of bridge, delighted Vanaras, destruction of sons, relatives and vehicles of Ravana's army, killing of Ravana who was a thorn in the eyes of god, coming of Brahma and gods, bestowing a boon and all that is known to me by the power of my penance. My disciples in Ayodhya communicated to me."
